milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the pink concrete pillar (center at spawn-relative [5.5, 1, 3.5]) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target.' The pink concrete is ~6.5 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=16 is generous enough to allow the agent to spot it from moderate range, while facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at the pink concrete rather than something else. This is preferred over position_inside_box because the task is about finding/observing, not just reaching a location.
